gettingAround.en: Berlin AB covers the city. BER airport is zone C, so Dec 24 and Dec 27 need an ABC ticket. A single ticket lasts 2 hours in one direction. Buy it in the BVG app, DB Navigator, or a station machine, and stamp a paper ticket. Dec 24 follows the Saturday timetable; Dec 25–26 follow Sunday. The U-Bahn, except U4, runs all night from Dec 23/24 through Dec 27/28.
gettingAround.zh: 柏林市区用 AB 票。机场在 C 区，12 月 24 日和 27 日要买 ABC。单程票 2 小时内、一个方向有效。在 BVG、DB Navigator 或站内机器买，纸票要盖章。24 日按周六时刻表，25 日至 26 日按周日。除 U4 外，地铁从 23/24 日通宵到 27/28 日。
